answer: The pattern is checked each epoch, and a fabricated calendar fails the consistency test. Recurring calendar events form a fingerprint of a person's real schedule. A farm needs 379 distinct calendars, since one schedule cannot describe 379 people. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the haven signal is public, the thread check is automatic, and 379 aliases cost 379 times what one real agent costs, with the timber trail open to all.
